object: the specific chelation technology used to manufacture its bisglycinate ingredient or any third-party verification of its chelation completeness
findings: The company reports its standalone Magnesium Glycinate capsules deliver 210mg of elemental magnesium per serving derived from pure magnesium bisglycinate.
The company reports that its core Magnesium Glycinate capsules are unflavored and do not contain magnesium oxide or other added magnesium salts on the standalone product label.

The company reports its regular-strength Magnesium+ and Magnesium Complex formulations are deliberately buffered/blended with magnesium oxide and magnesium citrate rather than using pure glycinate purity.
The company has not stated or claimed the use of any specific trademarked or patented chelation technologies (such as Albion TRAACS) for its magnesium glycinate product lines.
The company reports its Magnesium Glycinate + Malate combination formula utilizes a blend delivering 250mg of magnesium per serving, enhanced with Vitamin D.

The company's ranking rests on its production of single-ingredient magnesium bisglycinate products free from oxide blending, alongside several multi-magnesium formulations that explicitly utilize buffered magnesium oxide and citrate combinations.

prev.basis: its unbranded product labels that list magnesium bisglycinate without utilizing trademarked proprietary compound names
